test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year did the government notify the New Public Sector Enterprise (PSE) Policy for Atma Nirbhar Bharat, that provides overall guidance on strategic disinvestment, and intends to minimise the presence of Government in PSEs across all sectors of economy?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New Public Sector Enterprise (PSE) Policy** was notified by the Government of India in the year **2021**.
 
• This policy is aligned with the vision of **Atma Nirbhar Bharat**, which aims to make India self-reliant across various sectors.
 
• The policy provides **guidance on strategic disinvestment** and seeks to reduce the presence of the government in **Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs)** across all sectors of the economy.
 
• It emphasizes that the **Government will only retain PSEs** in strategic sectors, while in non-strategic sectors, **PSEs will either be privatized or closed.**
 
• The strategic sectors identified under the policy include areas such as **atomic energy, defense, transport, telecommunications, banking, and insurance.**
 
• The policy supports the Government’s effort to **optimize resource allocation**, enhance efficiency, and facilitate growth by allowing private sector participation in industries previously dominated by the public sector.
 
• Strategic disinvestment and privatization under the policy aim to unlock the potential of PSEs by improving their **competitiveness, profitability, and operational efficiency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2025**__

 __
 
• This year is a future date and does not relate to the notification of the **New Public Sector Enterprise Policy.**
 
 
 
• **2024**__
 __
 
• This is another future date and does not correspond to the introduction of the policy.
 
 
 
• **2023**__
 
 
• While **2023** is a recent year, the **New Public Sector Enterprise Policy** was already notified earlier in **2021**.
